div.div: مُتَلَمَّظٌ The part of the face by which smiling is expressed; syn. مُتَبَسَّمٌ. (K. TA) [in the CK, erroneously, مُتَبَسِّم.]) You say, إِنَّهُ لَحَسَنُ المُتَلَمَّظِ [Verily he is goodly in respect of the part of the face by which smiling is expressed]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
